info.title: Transform fixture API
info.description: Synthetic spec exercising every transform in generate_types.sh. Used by codegen_test.go.

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Chain id declared as number; fix_chain_id_number_types must convert it to integer.

parameters.name: amounts
parameters.description: Malformed array type; check_and_fix_incorrect_number_arrays must rewrite it.

parameters.name: gasPrice
parameters.description: anyOf parameter; change_any_of_int_to_int must collapse it to the first variant.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: anyOf with a null variant listed first; remove_null_schemas must drop it before change_any_of_int_to_int collapses the rest.

parameters.name: note
parameters.description: Optional string; add_pointer_skip_field must prevent pointer generation.

price.description: A non-chain number field; must remain float32.

srcChainId.description: Chain id property declared as number; must be generated as int.

optionalNote.description: Optional property; add_pointer_skip_field must prevent pointer generation.

linked.description: allOf wrapper around a ref; change_any_of_ref_to_ref must collapse it to the bare ref.
